answer.reason: The verses tell that the ark stayed in his house three months and the LORD blessed him and his household.

clauses.english: housed the ark of the LORD for three months and was blessed by the LORD with all his household
clauses.quote: the LORD blessed Obededom, and all his household

doubts: The summary already names the house where the ark rested, so the clause adds the blessing and the three months.
1CH 15:24 names an Obededom as doorkeeper, which may be a different man of the same name, so it was left out.
